mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lecture_evaluation_achievements ( management_no, teacher_user_id, evaluation_year, organization_code, management_item_code, occurred_date, achievement_detail, attachment_ref, created_by, updated_by, change_reason ) VALUES ( #{managementNo}, #{teacherUserId}, #{evaluationYear}, #{organizationCode}, #{managementItemCode}, #{occurredDate}, CAST(#{achievementDetail} AS jsonb), #{attachmentRef}, #{createdBy}, #{createdBy}, #{changeReason} )
mapper.update: UPDATE lecture_evaluation_achievements SET management_item_code = #{managementItemCode}, occurred_date = #{occurredDate}, achievement_detail = CAST(#{achievementDetail} AS jsonb), attachment_ref = #{attachmentRef}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, change_reason = #{changeReason} WHERE achievement_id = #{achievementId} AND deleted_yn = 'N' AND certification_status <> 'EVALUATION_CONFIRMED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO data_change_histories ( target_business, target_key, change_type, field_name, before_value, after_value, changed_by, change_reason ) VALUES ( 'lecture_evaluation_achievements', CAST(#{achievementId} AS varchar), #{changeType}, #{fieldName}, #{beforeValue}, #{afterValue}, #{changedBy}, #{changeReason} )
mapper.update: UPDATE lecture_evaluation_achievements SET certification_status = #{nextStatus}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, change_reason = #{changeReason} WHERE achievement_id = #{achievementId} AND deleted_yn = 'N' AND certification_status <> 'EVALUATION_CONFIRMED'
